title: RDP: Various fixes and improvement
description: This batch of patches contains improvements of the info column for RDP related dissectors. It also improves the dissectors of various RDP channels.

commits_data.title: rdp: various display improvements
commits_data.message:
rdp: various display improvements

This patch reworks the display of clientNetworkData so that the name of the channel
is more obvious. We also show the channelId. It also fixes the info column when
there's multiple messages.
And finally it registers the RDP dissector in heuristic lists of TLS and websocket,
preparing the correct dissecting of ARM traffic (RDP on top of websocket).

commits_data.title: rdp_rail: add new commands and fix display of multiple messages
commits_data.message:
rdp_rail: add new commands and fix display of multiple messages

Add some more commands in RAILs (not officially documented by MS), and fix the
display of the INFO column when multiple messages are present.

commits_data.title: rdp_egfx: various dissector improvements
commits_data.message:
rdp_egfx: various dissector improvements

This patch adds the dissecting of commands with a surfaceId. It also adds new
capability sets that are present when connecting with msrdc.

commits_data.title: rdp_drdynvc: various changes in the info column display
commits_data.message:
rdp_drdynvc: various changes in the info column display

Ths patch adds more info in the info column when it's creation of dynamic channels.
It also fixes the display of multiple message by separating them with coma. And
finally it also wires the RAIL channel transported on the dynamic channel that has
a different channel name.

commits_data.title: rdp: adjust info column display for multiple messages
commits_data.message:
rdp: adjust info column display for multiple messages

Use a comma separated display so that multiple messages are displayed nicely in
rdp_cliprdr and rdp_dr.
